steps.en: The hirer or driver details are recorded in OCMS
steps.id: Data hirer atau driver tercatat di OCMS

steps.en: The notice returns automatically to the first reminder stage
steps.id: Notice otomatis kembali ke tahap reminder pertama

steps.en: The revert only happens when set conditions are met
steps.id: Revert hanya terjadi bila kondisi yang ditetapkan terpenuhi

steps.en: The new stage shows in the online payment portal
steps.id: Tahap baru muncul di portal pembayaran online
steps.why_en: The automatic path updates it at once, but the staff path relies on a sync that earlier missed some notices.
steps.why_id: Jalur otomatis langsung memperbarui, tetapi jalur staff bergantung pada sync yang sebelumnya sempat melewatkan sebagian notice.

steps.en: Reminders go to the hirer or driver per the workflow
steps.id: Reminder dikirim ke hirer atau driver sesuai workflow
steps.why_en: Letters need a manual trigger, and printer upload, text messages and email are switched off in the settings.
steps.why_id: Surat perlu pemicu manual, dan upload ke percetakan, SMS serta email dimatikan di pengaturan.
